phase2.promptExact: Single isolated single-pose EDIT. Reference order is binding: FIRST reference is a flat grey-mannequin pose guide on magenta — copy its EXACT pose, silhouette, proportions, limb placement and weapon placement limb-for-limb, but do NOT copy the grey mannequin surface or the magenta background. SECOND reference (banked Xu Chu walk:2 anchor) and THIRD reference (banked Xu Chu walk:4 anchor) fix the identity, costume, glaive design, body scale and ground: huge blunt-faced helmeted dark/full-bearded ochre/dark-armoured boss Xu Chu, orthographic right-facing three-quarter gameplay camera, same lighting, plain dark background like the anchors. Paint the fully rendered Xu Chu of references 2-3 in exactly the guide pose: walk:5 BRAKE / bookend transition — a heavy warrior jamming to a stop and sitting his weight BACK. FRONT BRAKING LEG exactly as guided: front heel planted far ahead of the hip line, the whole front leg one near-straight DIAGONAL STRUT leaning down-forward from hip to heel (shin clearly diagonal, absolutely not vertical), knee nearly straight and braced, heel digging in with braking pressure, boot flat toe forward, front boot the forward-most point of the lower body. HIPS LOW AND BACK behind that strut, torso upright, head above the rear leg, mass settling back toward guard. REAR SUPPORT LEG exactly as guided: close under the hips with the ankle almost directly below the rear hip, knee bent absorbing the settling weight, rear boot in partial contact with heel only slightly raised — catching the weight beside/under the body, NOT stretched far behind in a trailing toe-off push. Both boots on the same ground level as the guide feet (double support, decelerating); no lifted passing leg, no forward walking contact stride, no square side-by-side guard stance. BODY SCALE MANDATORY: crown-to-sole height matches the guide and anchors exactly, 918px on the 1024 canvas (459px at 512 scale), no shrinking to fit, soles at the guide foot level near the canvas bottom. WEAPON: the whole single rigid glaive completely inside the frame, blade tip at least 40px inside every edge, never clipped; length matches the anchor ratio exactly (weapon 503px against a 459px body at 512 scale); shaft rising to the right at about 26 degrees, butt cap behind the rear hand, red tassel under the blade socket, both hands firmly gripping the shaft where the guide hands sit. Exactly ONE glaive and one full-body figure. Do NOT draw the magenta background, any grey mannequin shading, or any green line, ground line, guide line, grid, marker or text in the output. No scenery, no other characters, no extra limbs; natural connected anatomy with authored hip/skirt overlap.
